docs.title: NEvo documentation
docs.summary: Curated, human-facing navigation hub linking architecture docs, package docs, guides, and ADRs by relationship — distinct from the auto-generated docs/index.generated.md.

docs.title: ExampleApp walkthrough
docs.summary: End-to-end guide to examples/ExampleApp's 5 projects: auth, a permission-checked command, the Document event-sourcing flow (and why it doesn't actually persist anything by default), and cross-service dispatch.

docs.title: Extending NEvo
docs.summary: How to add a new transport, persistence mechanism, handler, or event type, each grounded in an existing package that already does it. Process only — see coding-conventions.md for standing coding rules this guide doesn't repeat.

docs.title: Installation
docs.summary: How to reference NEvo packages in a new project today, and the open question around NuGet publishing this guide does not paper over.

docs.title: Quick start
docs.summary: Minimal working setup using NEvo.Core and NEvo.Messaging: register the pipeline, understand what raw NEvo.Messaging gives you, and why the very next package most consumers add is NEvo.Messaging.Cqrs.

docs.title: Package classification
docs.summary: Groups all 13 real src/ packages (confirmed via `dotnet sln NEvo.sln list`) into functional categories, as the entry point for the per-package documentation under docs/packages/.

docs.title: NEvo.Authorization
docs.summary: Core authorization abstractions: user/role/permission provider contracts and a data-scope-aware role/permission model. Transport-agnostic — consumed by both NEvo.Messaging.Authorization and NEvo.Web.Authorization.

docs.title: NEvo.Core
docs.summary: Root of the dependency graph: functional primitives (Either-based error handling, argument checks) and the generic middleware-pipeline abstraction every processing pipeline in NEvo (messaging, and by extension its extensions) is built on.

docs.title: NEvo.Ddd.EventSourcing
docs.summary: Event-sourced aggregates: decide (command -> events) and evolve (events -> state) building blocks, wired into the NEvo.Messaging.Cqrs command pipeline. The default IEventStore registered by this package is a non-functional stub — see Limitations.

docs.title: NEvo.EntityFramework
docs.summary: Shared EF Core infrastructure: startup migrations with retry, and a telemetry activity-source name. Not a dependency of NEvo.Messaging.EntityFramework or NEvo.Orchestrating.EntityFramework — see Related packages.

docs.title: NEvo.Messaging
docs.summary: Message processing pipeline: dispatch, middleware chain, handler resolution, context propagation, and opt-in inbox/outbox abstractions. The foundation every NEvo.Messaging.* extension package builds on.

docs.title: NEvo.Messaging.Authorization
docs.summary: Auth hooks for the message pipeline: populates a per-request UserContext from NEvo.Authorization providers and validates per-handler permissions via an attribute. No DI registration helper exists yet — see Configuration.

docs.title: NEvo.Messaging.Cqrs
docs.summary: CQRS command side on top of NEvo.Messaging: Command base type, ICommandHandler, ICommandDispatcher. Query-side support is not implemented — see Limitations.

docs.title: NEvo.Messaging.EntityFramework
docs.summary: EF Core-backed implementations of NEvo.Messaging's inbox (idempotency) and outbox (transactional publishing) abstractions. Only inbox has a DI registration helper — see Limitations.

docs.title: NEvo.Messaging.Web
docs.summary: HTTP transport for messaging: REST dispatch to external services and ASP.NET Core route mapping for commands and generic message envelopes.

docs.title: NEvo.Orchestrating
docs.summary: Saga-style orchestration: sequential step execution with automatic reverse-order compensation on failure. Experimental and in progress — deliberately decoupled from the messaging pipeline (depends only on NEvo.Core).

docs.title: NEvo.Orchestrating.EntityFramework
docs.summary: EF entity shape and table configuration for orchestrator state. Does not itself implement IOrchestratorStateRepository — see Limitations.

docs.title: NEvo.Web
docs.summary: HTTP client wrapper: named/configured HttpClient instances with pluggable authentication (OAuth client-credentials or none) and a REST client base. Not ASP.NET Core middleware or routing, despite the name.

docs.title: NEvo.Web.Authorization
docs.summary: Adapts ASP.NET Core's ClaimsPrincipal into NEvo.Authorization's IUserProvider/ IRoleProvider abstractions. Despite the name, does not depend on NEvo.Web.

docs.title: Event sourcing
docs.summary: Experimental event sourcing implementation. In progress. Do not use as the basis for refactoring other modules. Characterization tests are needed before changes.

docs.title: Inbox and outbox
docs.summary: Inbox (idempotency) and outbox (transactional message publishing) abstractions. Both are opt-in — not required for basic messaging scenarios.

docs.title: Message context
read_when: working with correlation or causation IDs
docs.summary: Describes IMessageContext, its propagation via AsyncLocal, header management, and the feature storage mechanism.

docs.title: Messaging pipeline
docs.summary: Describes message dispatch, middleware chain execution, processing strategy resolution, and handler invocation. Entry point: IMessageProcessor.

docs.title: Orchestration
docs.summary: Experimental saga orchestration implementation. In progress. Decoupled from messaging. Do not use as basis for refactoring other modules.

docs.title: NEvo architecture overview
docs.summary: High-level overview of NEvo's modular structure, design philosophy, and current maturity status of each module.

docs.title: Package boundaries
read_when: evaluating whether a new package is needed
docs.summary: Dependency graph, allowed reference directions, and modularity rules. Core rule: dependencies flow downward only. No upward references.

docs.title: Persistence
docs.summary: Current EF Core integration, DbContext usage, and open questions around transaction ownership. Transaction semantics are explicitly unresolved.

docs.title: Processing model
docs.summary: Describes how NEvo selects a processing strategy for a given message and how handlers are resolved. Strategy pattern with factory, predicate-filtered selection.

docs.title: Coding conventions
read_when: writing new code in any NEvo package
deciding how to signal a failure
docs.summary: Standing rules a contributor follows regardless of what they're building: the Either<Exception, T> error convention, dependency-direction, DI registration shape, and constructor null-checking. Cross-links the extension workflow rather than duplicating it.

docs.title: Commit conventions
docs.summary: Conventional Commits format adopted for this project. PR title is the squash commit message — it must follow this format.

docs.title: Git workflow
docs.summary: Branch naming, PR strategy, merge model, and specs CLI integration for branch lifecycle.

docs.title: Local setup
docs.summary: Prerequisites, build commands, and how to run the example applications locally.

docs.title: Pull requests
docs.summary: PR format, required fields by change class, and review expectations.

docs.title: Testing
docs.summary: Test stack, project structure, coverage expectations, and conventions. Integration tests for the messaging pipeline do not yet exist — this is a known gap.
